success_outcomes: A new process identifies exactly one valid next action from repository-visible state
Valid artifact envelopes, matching source pins, and owner verification receipts advance the attempt to succeeded
A recovered ambiguous effect attaches an owner inspection receipt and completes without duplicate publication
failure_outcomes: Missing or mismatching source/workspace/capability pins fail closed on attempt startup
Corrupt or schema-invalid artifact envelopes fail artifact gates with repairable pointers
Unsupported host adapter capability halts attempt and signals owner incompatibility
waiting_outcomes: Pending human or security approval transitions attempt to waiting with a resolvable pending-action pointer
Process loss after an external side effect leaves the attempt waiting with an ambiguous-effect pointer
stop_outcomes: Attempt execution halts immediately upon ambiguous side effect without automatic replay
Attempt execution halts when normative contract delta is detected during an immutable round

triggered_mechanisms.observable_condition: Ordered context must survive a fresh process
triggered_mechanisms.necessity_criterion: Process loss requires fresh session to reload exact context without opaque prompt assembly

triggered_mechanisms.observable_condition: An attempt must pause, resume, cancel, or correlate retries
triggered_mechanisms.necessity_criterion: Cross-session continuation requires repository-visible run_id, step, status, and event cursor
Owner verification receipts must be checkable by gates before advancing steps

triggered_mechanisms.observable_condition: Invocation, resume, approvals, sandbox, or traces differ by host
triggered_mechanisms.necessity_criterion: Different host environments require standard capability negotiation and pointer passing

triggered_mechanisms.observable_condition: Human input or permission is pending
triggered_mechanisms.necessity_criterion: Security approval requires waiting state with pending-action pointer without synthesized authority

triggered_mechanisms.observable_condition: An effect may replay after process loss
triggered_mechanisms.necessity_criterion: Crash after publication must stop retries and await owner inspection receipt instead of duplicate replay

triggered_mechanisms.observable_condition: Diagnosis or cross-host comparison needs correlation
triggered_mechanisms.necessity_criterion: Normalized lifecycle events must carry run, attempt, step, and host trace correlation

normalized_events.payload_summary: Validated source pins and loaded context manifest
Security boundary approval pending from human maintainer
Process loss followed review publication; awaiting owner inspection receipt

pin_mismatch.resolution: Stop immediately; load exact owner-approved source pins and restart or open compatible attempt

invalid_artifact_or_receipt.resolution: Preserve failure, repair only named owner artifact, and rerun affected gate without restarting unrelated work

human_or_approval_pending.resolution: Remain in waiting status with resolvable pointer; never synthesize or bypass human/security decision

ambiguous_side_effect.resolution: Stop automatic retries, preserve idempotency and correlation references, obtain owner inspection receipt, and resume or compensate through owner

unsupported_capability.resolution: Fail closed, record capability deficit, and hand incompatibility to host owner

normative_delta.resolution: Stop immutable round; accepted changes start a new round and rebuild downstream consumers

lifecycle.ownership: Harness Teaching Skill Owner (lesson and fixtures) & Source Owners (normative content and adapters)
review_triggers: Observed continuation failure not covered by existing triggers
Repeated learner failure or failed transfer
Measured requirement for concurrency or remote coordination
lifecycle.feedback_and_deviations: No deviations from pointer-only single-ownership contract permitted in active round
lifecycle.kernel_deletion_rule: Inline or delete the orchestration kernel when a thinner boundary (e.g. skill-loader-plus-owner-artifacts) satisfies all required lifecycle invariants without hidden state or human memory
retirement_criteria: Method Contract superseded by incompatible v2 contract
Native host provides guaranteed cross-session pointer persistence and verification gates
